claims.location: comment[data file], assay name, comment[fraction identifier], comment[technical replicate] rows 1-48
claims.value: one RAW per run; fraction 1; technical replicate 1
claims.evidence: files list holds 48 RAW named <date>_Bldg49_SL_<D7|D15>_<NT|KD>_<H|L>_<1-6>.raw; this part holds the 24 _H_ runs. The PD export treats each RAW as one sample (F1-F48), no fractionation; paper describes single 2 uL injections.
Key resources table: 'Cell line (Homo sapiens) i11w-mNC'; NCBITaxon:9606.
Every run is an experimental iNeuron culture (BORCS6 KD or NT guide); no reference or QC runs deposited.
Each run is one culture well set of one condition and replicate (PD sample names '<group>, <rep>'); no pooling described.

Proteomic sample preparation: 'BORC knockdown and NT control i11w-mNC cells were cultured and differentiated'. i11w-mNC = WTC11 with dox-inducible mNGN2 (i11w-mN, Wang et al. 2017) plus dCas9-KRAB (Tian et al. 2019). NOT the Halo-TDP-43 knock-in line (i11w-hT), which was used for the screen and imaging only. Kept verbatim: no Cellosaurus entry for the dCas9 derivative (validator warning: not in clo/bto/efo).

i11w-mNC has no Cellosaurus record; its parent i11w-mN is CVCL_C7XJ (Pre-i3Neuron NGN2 iPSC clone 1) and the root line is CVCL_Y803 (GM25256/WTC-11). The parent accession is not written because it would describe a different line.
Paper: 'WTC11 cells were derived from an apparently healthy 30-year-old male.' Cellosaurus CVCL_Y803/CVCL_C7XJ: SX Male, AG 30Y.
Donor age 30Y (>= 20Y, campaign rule 9); EFO:0001272.
Cellosaurus CVCL_Y803 and CVCL_C7XJ: 'Population: Japanese'; HANCESTRO:0019.
All cultures derive from the single WTC11 donor (one iPSC line). Underscore form because the human-template identifier validator rejects spaces.
'apparently healthy 30-year-old male' donor; no disease model introduced (BORCS6 CRISPRi knockdown is recorded under genotype). PATO:0000461.
In-vitro iPSC-derived neurons; no tissue was sampled (iPSC donor tissue was skin fibroblast per Cellosaurus, not the sample).
Samples are iNeurons: iPSCs differentiated by dox-induced NGN2 and harvested on day 7 and day 15 ('Protein was extracted from day 7 and day 15 neurons'). CL:0000540.
Differentiated neurons lysed in the well (SP3 lysis buffer added directly to the wells).
Not stated.

From day 5 until harvest both arms were in SILAC DMEM: 'heavy-SILAC media ... DMEM for SILAC (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 88364) supplemented with B27 Plus...'; 'Remaining cultures were maintained in light SILAC media'. NCIT:C185409. (Days 0-3 induction medium KO DMEM/F12; day 3-5 BrainPhys maturation medium.)

claims.value: BORCS6 knockdown (CRISPRi sgRNA) / non-targeting control sgRNA (CRISPRi)
claims.evidence: Paper: 'dynamic SILAC ... as well as whole neuron proteomics to measure protein abundances in BORCS6 KD and NT iNeurons'; file token KD/NT; PD groups D*_KD_* / D*_NT_*. Custom characteristics column (genotype is licensed by clinical-metadata, which is not declared; rule 15). Data check: BORCS6 (Q96GS4) light abundance is reported only in NT_L runs (F44, F20, F24), never in KD runs (ratio_check.txt).

claims.evidence: 'Cells were harvested on day 7 and day 15 post dox induction.' File token D7/D15; Fig 8 (d7) and Fig 8-figure supplement 1 (d15).

claims.value: 1-6 within each genotype x day group
claims.evidence: File suffix _1.._6 and PD sample names '<group>, <rep>, <rep>' give 6 runs per group; Fig 8 legend 'n=6'. Each replicate is a separate culture, so numbers 1-6 are unique within each factor group (rule 3); light and heavy rows of one run come from the same culture and share its number.
Rule 1. human: human cells; cell-lines: cultured iPSC-derived line. No clinical template (not patient samples).
Campaign rule 10.
All 48 RAW headers: 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Method Summary'; paper LC-MS analysis: 'Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Lumos Tribrid'. PRIDE's 'Orbitrap Eclipse' is contradicted by raw and paper.

RAW: 'Scan ddMSnScan', 'Data Dependent Mode= Cycle Time' (3 s); paper and PRIDE protocol: 'acquired in data-dependent mode'. PRIDE experiment_types 'Data-independent acquisition' contradicts its own protocol text.
'eluted in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate with 20 ug/mL lyophilized trypsin/LysC (Promega, V5073)'. Two enzymes -> second column (rule 2), inserted by postbuild.py because build drops the second value.
RAW: 'ActivationType = HCD', 'Collision Energy Type = Normalized', 'Collision Energy (%) = 30' in all 48; paper 'HCD ... collision energy was set at 30%'.
RAW ddMSnScan 'Detector Type = IonTrap', 'Ion Trap Scan Rate = Rapid'; paper 'MS2 scans were conducted in the ion trap'. The Fusion Lumos ion trap is a radial-ejection linear trap.
RAW MasterScan 'Scan Range (m/z) = 375-1500' (all 48); paper 'mass range of 375-1500 m/z'.
Single-shot injections, no fractionation described.
Lysis buffer contains '5 mM Dithiothreitol [DTT]'; 'Proteins were alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide ... then reduced by adding 2 uL of 500 mM DTT'.

claims.evidence: MaxQuant 1.6.14 search: 'Precursor and fragment tolerances were set to 25 ppm.'

claims.value: Nethylmaleimide C, Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term (all Variable); Label:13C(6)15N(2) K (UNIMOD:259) and Label:13C(6)15N(4) R (UNIMOD:267), Variable
claims.evidence: Paper/PRIDE data processing (MaxQuant 1.6.14): 'A maximum of three variable modifications was allowed for cysteine N-ethylmaleimide, methionine oxidation, and protein N-terminus acetylation.' 'A standard multiplicity with two labels was enabled for SILAC data, and Lys8/Arg10 was selected as the heavy channel.' Lys8 = 13C6 15N2 (+8.014, UNIMOD:259), Arg10 = 13C6 15N4 (+10.008, UNIMOD:267), matching the heavy media isotopes CNLM-291-H / CNLM-539-H. MT=Variable per rule 11. No fixed Carbamidomethyl is stated, so none is asserted although alkylation used iodoacetamide (conflict noted in limitations).

claims.value: SILAC light (odd rows) / SILAC heavy (even rows)
claims.evidence: dSILAC: cultures switched to heavy Lys8/Arg10 medium on day 5; light = protein made before the switch, heavy = protein synthesized after it; half-life t1/2 = ts*ln2/ln(1+R) with R = H/L (Proteomic data analysis). PD export: 'Light, Control' / 'Heavy, Sample' per run. Data check (ratio_check.txt): median H/L per _H_ run D7_NT 0.62-0.65, D7_KD 0.45-0.49, D15_NT 1.85-2.70, D15_KD 1.15-1.50, consistent with 2 vs 10 days of labelling and the paper's longer half-lives under BORCS6 KD; TDP-43 (Q13148) H/L lower in KD (D7 0.27-0.31 vs NT 0.37-0.48), matching Fig 8C.
One source per (run, channel): light channel = pre-existing proteome, heavy = newly synthesized proteome of the same culture (as in passed PXD028934).

Heavy medium from day 5 ('On day 5, half of the cultures were changed to heavy-SILAC media'), harvest on day 7 or 15 -> labelling time ts = 2 or 10 days. Custom column (clinical-metadata term, not declared; rule 15).

limitations: Search: the deposited search result is a Proteome Discoverer 2.4.1.15 protein export (pdResult not deposited, so PD parameters are unknown) that searched all 48 runs as a SILAC 2-plex. The paper and PRIDE text describe MaxQuant 1.6.14; modification parameters and tolerances follow that published description. MaxQuant search outputs (peptide.txt, protein.txt) are not deposited.
Modifications: the paper lists cysteine N-ethylmaleimide as a variable mod although alkylation used iodoacetamide; no fixed Carbamidomethyl is stated. Encoded as stated; Carbamidomethyl not asserted.

Phosphosites in light-only runs were identified with a separate FragPipe LFQ-phospho workflow (MSFragger/PTMProphet/Philosopher) whose parameters are not reported; that search is not encoded (the -lfq file describes the MaxQuant non-SILAC search).
MaxQuant digestion rule not stated; cleavage agents encode the Trypsin/Lys-C digestion mix (rule 2).

Cell line i11w-mNC (WTC11 + mNGN2 + dCas9-KRAB) has no Cellosaurus entry; cellosaurus accession/name not available; parent i11w-mN = CVCL_C7XJ, root WTC-11 = CVCL_Y803. The validator warns that 'i11w-mNC' is not in CLO/BTO/EFO.
PRIDE structured fields are wrong: instrument 'Orbitrap Eclipse' (raw: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos) and experiment type 'Data-independent acquisition' (raw and protocol: DDA).
Whether replicate k of different groups (and of the H vs L arms) came from the same differentiation batch is not stated; replicate numbers are only unique within each factor group.
BORCS6 sgRNA sequence is in Supplementary file 5 (not consulted); not needed for any SDRF value.
